editorial:
You follow a crew of young horror web series hosts who decide to livestream from an abandoned asylum that locals say is cursed. They set up cameras everywhere and split up to explore the dark hallways. At first it feels like a fun, spooky adventure, but things quickly go wrong as strange noises, moving shadows, and locked doors make it clear they are not alone. The found-footage style puts you right in the middle of the action, making every corner feel dangerous.

The acting feels natural and the scares build slowly before hitting hard. The pacing is tight and the tension never lets up once things start going wrong. On the downside, some characters make dumb choices and the ending can feel abrupt. Still, if you love found-footage horror like The Blair Witch Project or REC, this one delivers real chills. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture and sound.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the crew members are picked off one by one as a ghostly presence takes over the asylum. The host who tried to keep the broadcast going is dragged away by an unseen force. The last camera shows an empty hallway before cutting to black. The twist is that the asylum itself seems alive, trapping anyone who enters, and the live stream ends with no survivors, leaving viewers wondering if the haunting was real or staged.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves found-footage horror and haunted house stories.
